scope: observability, alerting, and production gate map

signals.name: request_id_propagation
signals.production_gate: must propagate request id through web, admin, backend, worker, crawler, logs, and traces

signals.name: structured_json_logs
signals.local_evidence: .env.example and docker-compose.yml define LOG_FORMAT=json and LOG_LEVEL
signals.production_gate: must verify backend, worker, crawler, and access logs are JSON with request_id, user_id, tenant_id, route, status, latency_ms, and error fields

signals.name: opentelemetry_traces
signals.production_gate: must verify backend, worker, crawler, provider, export, and object storage spans in staging

signals.name: backend_worker_crawler_metrics
signals.production_gate: must expose API latency, queue delay, generation duration, export duration, crawler throttle, quota contention, and error counters

signals.name: frontend_error_reporting
signals.local_evidence: .env.example defines FRONTEND_ERROR_REPORTING_DSN empty for local alpha
signals.production_gate: must configure web/admin error reporting with release SHA and source map policy

signals.name: dashboards
signals.local_evidence: ops/runbooks/stage0_ops.md defines SLOs and drill commands
signals.production_gate: must publish staging dashboards for API, worker, provider, export, quota, crawler, object storage, billing, safety, and admin failures

signals.name: alerts
signals.local_evidence: ops/runbooks/stage0_ops.md defines incident severity and escalation
signals.production_gate: must configure paging/notification routes and alert thresholds before private beta
